scope.arrival_schedule: 20 messages scheduled every 50 ms; actual enqueue lateness is retained.
scope.claim: Transport-fault emulation on this host; not validated radio anti-jamming.
scope.clock: Same-host monotonic clock; latency measured from actual enqueue start, not fictitious payload clocks.
scope.controller_inputs: Only completed network observations; profile and phase labels are fixture/postanalysis only.
scope.effect: One unique committed witness ledger row per message ID.
scope.fault_schedule: Fixed 300–1000 ms disruption. ACK losses keyed to first requests for messages 7–14.
scope.payloads: 20 nonsecret fictitious messages; identical canonical bytes across paired modes.
scope.restart: Both modes killed at 600 ms and restarted at 700 ms in blackout_return.
scope.success_semantics: success means the experiment completed with valid evidence; complete delivery is separately reported as all_messages_delivered_and_acked.
